meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把数据整理成有开头、冲突、结论的叙事报告,包含背景、洞察、建议和行动号召;还能按问题解决、趋势或对比等框架组织内容,并配图表建议。
howto.when: 在向高管或非技术受众展示数据分析、制作季度业务回顾或投资者演示等场景触发。

say.text: 把这份客户流失数据写成问题解决式故事报告
say.note: 会输出含钩子、背景、洞察、方案和行动号召的完整叙事。

say.text: 用趋势故事框架分析Q4业绩,加入对比图表
say.note: 会按时间线、关键转变和洞察组织,并给出图表建议。

say.text: 比较EMEA和APAC市场机会,给加权评分和推荐
say.note: 会产出对比分析、评分矩阵和风险缓解建议。

howto.what_en: Transforms raw data into narrative reports with a setup-conflict-resolution arc, including insights, recommendations, and next steps. Offers frameworks (problem-solution, trend, comparison), chart guidance, and presentation templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when presenting analytics to executives, creating quarterly business reviews, or building investor presentations.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into a problem-solution story report.
Use the trend-story framework to analyze Q4 performance with comparison charts.
say_en.note: Organizes as timeline, shift, and insight with visual suggestions.

say_en.text: Compare EMEA vs APAC market opportunity with weighted scores and a recommendation.
say_en.note: Produces comparison, scoring matrix, and risk mitigation.
